# agyn_private_resource_access (Resource)

Manages an Agyn private resource access grant.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `principal_id` (String) Principal identifier.
- `principal_type` (String) Principal type. One of `agent`, `user`, `app`, or `group`.
- `private_resource_id` (String) Private resource identifier.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID identifier of the private resource access grant.
- `provisioning_state` (String) OpenZiti provisioning state.
